name: Scouring Pool

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-16: The Heart of the City

stealth.details: (expert) to notice the enticing effects of the pool

disable: DC 27 Thievery check to scratch out the runes creating the effect, DC 23 Occultism check (expert) or DC 23 Demon-lore check (expert) to determine the password that identifies the party as believers, or Dispel Magic (3rd-rank; counteract DC 25); two total successes are required to deactivate the pool.
routine:
(1 action; mental) The cleansing pool uses its first action to try and compel all creatures within 5 feet to enter into the pool. Creatures must attempt a DC 23 Will save save.

---
Critical Success The creature is immune to the pool's routine for 1 minute.
Success No effect.
Failure The creature gains the Fascinated condition and attempts to enter the pool.
Critical Failure As failure, but the creature must also use all of their actions on their next turn to try and pull one of their allies into the pool with them.

items.name: Echoing Spring
items.text:
Trigger a creature within 10 feet can see or hear the cleansing pool

---
Effect each creature within range must succeed a DC 25 Will save save or become Fascinated, using all of their available actions to move toward and into the pool. The hazard then rolls initiative.

items.name: Drown the Nonbelievers
items.text:
Trigger a Fascinated creature enters the pool

---
Effect the waters rush up to encircle the creature, which must succeed on a DC 25 Fortitude save save or begin drowning.

text: The swirling water in this pool entices anyone who can see or hear it to wander into its depths, drowning its victims.
